name: 无差别破坏
desc: 每次自己的准备阶段掷1次骰子。1～5的数目出现的场合，场上表侧表示存在的和出现的数目相同等级的怪兽全部破坏。6的数目出现的场合，场上表侧表示存在的6星以上的怪兽全部破坏。
faq: Rolling a die is not optional, you must roll one each of your Standby Phases. If you have two copies of "Blind Destruction" active on the field you roll two dice each of your Standby Phases.
ruling: Face-down monsters are not affected by “Blind Destruction.”
